info.description: Most capable reasoning model for complex software engineering, mathematical and scientific problem solving, high factual accuracy, autonomous multi-step agents, and long decode up to 1M tokens. Stable on the Gemini API. The default synchronous max output is 65,536 tokens; long decode can continue up to 1,048,576 tokens minus the input. Standard price is $4 input, $20 output, and $0.20 implicit cache read per 1M tokens. Thinking levels are low, medium (default), and high. Also supports code execution, computer use, search and Maps grounding, URL context, and file search. Caching is implicit only. Batch, Flex, and Priority inference are supported.

zh.description: 最强推理模型，面向复杂软件工程、数学与科学问题求解、高事实准确性、自主多步智能体，以及最长 100 万 token 的 long decode。在 Gemini API 上为稳定版。同步默认最大输出为 65,536 token；开启 long decode 后，输出可延续到 1,048,576 减去输入。标准价为每百万 token 输入 4 美元、输出 20 美元、隐式缓存读取 0.20 美元。思考档位为 low、medium（默认）和 high。另支持代码执行、Computer use、Search 与 Maps grounding、URL context 和 File search。仅支持隐式缓存。支持 Batch、Flex 和 Priority 推理。
